name: Does my business insurance cover water damage in my restaurant?

mainEntity.name: Does my business insurance cover water damage in my restaurant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most commercial property insurance policies include coverage for certain types of water damage. Typically, sudden and accidental water damage, such as from a burst pipe, is covered. However, damage resulting from neglect, maintenance issues, or specific types of flooding (e.g., natural flood not covered by a separate flood insurance policy) may not be. Review your specific policy details or consult your insurance provider to understand your coverage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, sudden and accidental water damage is covered by commercial property insurance, but check your specific policy for exclusions like neglect or natural flooding.
